ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PowerShell Mailbox SMTP Forward Rule
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the powerShell Set-Mailbox Cmdlet to set-up an SMTP forwarding rule. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-Mailbox\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-DeliverToMailboxAndForward\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-ForwardingSmtpAddress\\ .*"))
